proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: In the Battle of Earth, Okoye kills Corvus Glaive, and Proxima Midnight cradles his body as Tony Stark's snap turns them both to dust.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow child of Thanos who holds Corvus's body as they turn to dust.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow child of Thanos, killed in the Battle of Earth. Proxima holds him as they turn to dust.

changes.evidence: Avengers: Endgame, Battle of Earth: Okoye impales Corvus on her spear; when Tony snaps, Proxima cradles Corvus's body and the two fade to dust together.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: In the Battle of Earth, Cull Obsidian tries to stab Tony Stark, but Peter webs him off his feet and Scott Lang crushes him underfoot.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Webs Cull off his feet in the Battle of Earth, leaving him to be crushed.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Black Order brute Peter webs off his feet before Scott crushes him.

changes.evidence: Avengers: Endgame: Cull corners Tony and goes to stab him with his arm blade; Peter pulls him off his feet with webbing, and Scott, giant-sized, stomps on him and kills him.

now.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
now.text: Cosmo joins the Guardians at their base on Knowhere. Quill leaves her and Kraglin to guard Knowhere, and she later links the two ships so Quill can bring the rescued children home.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The Guardians' leader, who leaves Cosmo to guard Knowhere.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian Quill leaves to guard Knowhere, who links the ships for the children.

proposed.text: Quill leaves Cosmo and Kraglin to guard Knowhere while the Guardians go to save Rocket. She later links the two ships so Quill can bring the rescued children home.

changes.evidence: Cosmo already joins the Guardians when they buy Knowhere, in The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special (she helps decorate the base there). In Vol. 3 she is not joining; the Guardians leave her and Kraglin in charge of Knowhere.

proposed.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
proposed.text: Darren Cross, now M.O.D.O.K. and working for Kang, shows himself to Hank, wrecks his ship and leaves him to die. He later turns on Kang and dies with Hank and his family around him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Cross's old mentor, whose ship he wrecks before turning on Kang and dying.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Hank's old protege, back as M.O.D.O.K. Wrecks his ship, then dies turning on Kang.

changes.evidence: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania: M.O.D.O.K. greets a shocked Hank ('Holy shit, Darren. What happened to you?'), attacks his ship and leaves him to die; later, persuaded by Cassie, he breaks Kang's shield and dies surrounded by Cassie, Scott, Hank and Hope.

proposed.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
proposed.text: Darren Cross returns as M.O.D.O.K., Kang's enforcer in the Quantum Realm. He later turns on Kang and, dying with Hope beside him, remarks on her new hair.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Cross's old colleague, beside him when he dies turning on Kang.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Hope's old boss, back as M.O.D.O.K. Dies beside her after turning on Kang.

changes.evidence: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania: M.O.D.O.K. turns against Kang and is mortally wounded; as he dies, surrounded by Cassie, Scott, Hank and Hope, he comments on Hope changing her hair.

proposed.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
proposed.text: Darcy stands by Jane through her stage four cancer, going with her to chemotherapy and urging her not to face it alone.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Close friend Darcy stands by through stage four cancer.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend who goes with Jane to chemotherapy and urges her not to face cancer alone.

changes.evidence: Thor: Love and Thunder: Darcy accompanies Jane to her chemotherapy at the hospital and tells her not to fight the cancer alone.

now.title: The Avengers
now.text: Nick Fury brings Erik Selvig into S.H.I.E.L.D. to study the Tesseract. Selvig is working on it when Loki arrives and takes control of his mind.
now.on_a_card_about_b: S.H.I.E.L.D. director who brings Selvig in to study the Tesseract.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Scientist Fury brings in to study the Tesseract.

proposed.title: Thor
proposed.text: Nick Fury brings Erik Selvig to a S.H.I.E.L.D. facility and asks him to study the Tesseract.

changes.evidence: Thor's post-credits scene (credits scenes belong to their film): Selvig is taken to a S.H.I.E.L.D. facility, where Fury opens a briefcase and asks him to study the cube. The connection starts there, not in The Avengers; the card lines stay true.

proposed.title: Thor
proposed.text: Unseen, Loki secretly works on Erik Selvig's mind and prompts him to agree to study the Tesseract for Nick Fury.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: God who secretly prompts Selvig to study the Tesseract.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Scientist Loki secretly prompts to study the Tesseract for S.H.I.E.L.D.

changes.evidence: Thor's post-credits scene: as Fury asks Selvig to study the Tesseract, an invisible Loki, seen in Selvig's reflection, secretly prompts him to agree. This comes before The Avengers, where Loki takes him over with the scepter.

owner_calls.question: In Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 the Gamora from 2014, who has no memory of Drax, works with him and the Guardians on the Orgoscope and Counter-Earth missions, then goes back to the Ravagers. Add a stage for that, as gamora|peter-quill has one?
options: Add a Vol. 3 ally stage: a Gamora from 2014 who does not remember Drax works with him to save Rocket
Leave as is: nothing turns between them directly
owner_calls.evidence: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3: Gamora joins Quill, Nebula, Drax and Mantis on the Orgoscope mission and helps Drax walk after the escape; she tells the team the Gamora they knew is not her, and stays with the Ravagers at the end. In Infinity War, Drax is not present at her death.
